zeroclaw.description: Ultra-lightweight Rust binary. Best for fast, simple shell interactions, quick queries, and minimal latency.

openclaw.description: Node.js based full agent. Best for complex, multi-step integrations and heavy data tasks.

hermes.description: Python based agent. Best for python-heavy data science tasks, reasoning, and local file operations.

nanobot.description: Micro agent. Best for extremely tiny, single-action background tasks or micro-optimizations.
